answer.label: Bill Murray credit unsupported
answer.sourceLine: The Daily Caller’s fact-check found no evidence of Murray saying this and linked its spread to a 2013 parody account. Barry Popik documents a related Congress wording in a 2010 Ken Huber opinion piece and earlier parallels. That history does not identify the creator of this exact government-worded sentence. Barry Popik’s earlier chronology ↗
